([[Arrahhsh's Aegis]]) == Notes == *These quests will affect the [[spawn]]s in this area: **[[City Under Attack]] **[[Stemming the Tide]] **[[The Convocation]] (Both [[Master Togo]] and [[Headmaster Greico]] will travel with you, but only the former will fight, while the latter won't and will [[body block]] allies.) **[[The Count's Daughter]] * The [[Yeti]] in this area charm the elder pets when you get into [[compass]] range. If you stay out of compass range and let heroes and henchmen kill the Yeti, you can tame an Elder Crane or Tiger. * As you approach [[Xuekao, the Deceptive]], use caution to avoid getting surrounded. Groups of [[Am Fah]] and [[Jade Brotherhood]] will spawn and fight each other; you can either join the brawl or let them fight it out and dispose of what remains. * Foes that only appear in [[Echovald Forest]] (e.g. Stone Scale Kirins) or [[the Jade Sea]] (e.g. Yeti) with the exception of Pongmei Valley will [[drop]]: ** Kurzick [[Key]]s or Luxon Keys in [[normal mode]], respectively, even though only [[Canthan Chest]]s spawn in this area. ** Weapons that typically only drop in Echovald Forest (e.g. [[:Category:Amber weapons|Amber weapons]]) or the Jade Sea (e.g. [[:Category:Jade weapons|Jade weapons]]), respectively. * Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 2.58% to the Canthan [[Cartographer]] title. *{{Vanquisher|count = 146|low = 127|high = 175}} ** You will not gain a [[faction]] bonus for vanquishing this area. However, you can acquire [[blessing]]s to gain points while killing foes from the [[Luxon Priest]] near [[Boreas Seabed (outpost)|Boreas Seabed]] or the Luxon/[[Kurzick Priest]] near [[Tanglewood Copse]]. ** You can skip fighting [[Meynsang the Sadistic]] by avoiding his spawn point. ** If you trigger the [[Jade Brotherhood]] and [[Am Fah]] groups near [[Xuekao, the Deceptive]], but leave the area without fighting them, it can save ~14 kills. This is easiest done by flagging a hero while most of the party stays near compass range. ** Some [[Canthan Guard]]s will fight the enemies on the map, and get killed by them. ==Trivia== *Called "Pongmei Foothills" in early beta. {{Explorable areas in Kaineng City}} [[de:Pongmei-Tal]]
